documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Tamsin Partners (fictional).
In this document "TPH" means Tamsin Partners. Tamsin Partners reports cash margin of 4.9% for FY2025. Tamsin Partners reports interest cover of 4x for FY2025. Tamsin Partners reports capex of $8.3m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. Tamsin AB reports revenue of $420.4m for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Tamsin Partners, the sponsor equity cure is: equity cure available twice over the life of the facility. The fiscal year of Tamsin Partners ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Tamsin Partners (fictional).
Tamsin Partners reports cash interest margin of 6.2% for FY2025. Tamsin Partners reports interest cover of 3.7x for FY2025. Tamsin Partners reports available liquidity of $28m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports customer concentration of 21.8% for FY2025. For Tamsin Partners, the sponsor equity cure is: no equity cure right.

documents.title: Compliance certificate
documents.text:
Compliance certificate — Tamsin Partners (fictional).
Tamsin Partners reports capex of $7.7m for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025) on a reported basis. Tamsin Ltd reports revenue of $482.6m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports approximately available liquidity of $27m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports customer concentration of 24.7% for FY2025. "cash interest margin" has the same meaning as "cash margin".
